uploadDescription: Add local images or multi-page files to your PDF.
pasteHint: Click, drag images here, or paste from your clipboard.
supportedFormatsLabel: JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, ICO, HEIC/HEIF, JPEG XL, JP2 and J2K. Support depends on the encoding.
localOnlyNote: Images stay in this browser session and are not uploaded.
queueDescription: Select the images or pages to include, then rotate and arrange them in PDF order.
emptyQueueDescription: Add images to build the PDF page order.
settingsDescription: Choose page size, orientation, fit, margin, and image quality.
pageSizeDescription: Each selected image or source page becomes one PDF page.
fitModeDescription: Contain keeps the full image visible; cover fills the page and may crop edges.
qualityDescription: Images are re-encoded as 8-bit sRGB JPEGs on white. Higher quality usually creates a larger PDF; HDR and high bit depth are reduced.
marginDescription: White space around each image, in millimeters.
resultDescription: Download the generated PDF when processing completes.
emptyResultDescription: Add images, adjust settings, then generate the PDF.
duplicateFileError: That image is already in the page queue.
invalidImageTypeError: This file is not a supported raster image.
invalidImageError: This image could not be read. Remove or deselect it before generating the PDF.
generateFailedError: PDF generation failed. No incomplete PDF was saved. Reopen the affected file or try another device.
noImagesError: Select at least one readable image or page before generating a PDF.
unreadableSelectionError: Remove or deselect unreadable pages before generating the PDF.
framesNote: Animation frames become separate still PDF pages. APNG provides only its default poster.
exportErrorLabel: Could not export {name}. No incomplete PDF was saved.

failures.unsupported: This file is not a supported raster image. Check the format rather than its filename extension.
failures.sequence: This container uses an unsupported JPEG 2000 variant or timed sequence. Open an individual JP2, J2K or other supported still image instead.
failures.invalid: The image is damaged or uses an unsupported encoding.
failures.resourceLimit: Your browser ran out of resources while opening this image. Try closing other tabs or use another device.
failures.engineError: The image decoder could not start. Check your connection and reopen the file.
